text:
amy (PM): Quick thread — need to lock the rerank API shape & launch gating by EOW. Key decisions: default `top_k`, truncation behavior (server vs client), score normalization, and backwards compatibility. Customer asks: Dropbox + ecom want stable scores and client-side control. cc @sofia @raj @tara

raj (eng): Can you list constraints? perf / cost targets? Also do we need to support variable candidate sizes in one request (mixed text + attachments)?

sofia (ml): For scoring normalization: recommend returning raw scores (logits) + optional normalized scores. Two normalization modes we use: `softmax` (prob-style) and `minmax` (preserve relative distances). Softmax helps when combining different model outputs; min-max helps explainability. Also suggest a stable scaling param so results don't shift after model updates.

mike (devex): SDK-wise prefer a single `scores` array and an optional `normalized_scores` array. Example request shape we can standardize on:

```json
{
  "query": "how to reset password",
  "candidates": ["docA","docB","docC"],
  "top_k": 10,
  "norm_method": "softmax"  // optional: [none|softmax|minmax]
}
```

tara (cs): Customers generally want default `top_k=10` but ability to request up to 200. A few enterprise customers (news aggregator) asked for 1000. Can we have a hard cap with tiering per contract?

raj (eng): Implementation notes: server-side truncation when candidate payload > 1MB total, but still need client warnings. Plan: support `top_k` param; if requested `top_k` exceeds allowed for the given payload size, return `413 Payload Too Large` with `Retry-After` suggestion OR a 200 with trimmed results + `X-Rerank-Warning` header depending on `truncate_policy`. Streaming incremental top_k would be nice but is a follow-up.

sofia (ml): For normalization API, add `norm_method` param with values [\"none\",\"softmax\",\"minmax\"] and `temperature` for softmax. Also include a `stable_scaling` flag defaulting to `true` to reduce post-deploy regressions. We should log pre/post normalization distributions for drift monitoring.

amy (PM): Proposed launch criteria: 1) API shape agreed and spec doc published; 2) SDKs updated with migration guide; 3) e2e perf tests (p99 latency targets for `top_k=50`); 4) backward-compatibility tests & migration window; 5) doc examples + customer beta (Dropbox + ecom).

deploy-bot: Reminder: canary deploy requires feature flag `rerank-v2`; coordinate rollout plan with infra.

mike (devex): For truncation UX propose a `truncate_policy` enum: [`fail`,`truncate`,`partial`]. Default = `truncate` with a warning header `X-Rerank-Warning: truncated to 200 candidates`. Will add examples in SDK and doc.

tara (cs): For support, we need a compatibility matrix and clear guidance when scores are not comparable across model versions (i.e., "normalized scores may change after model update"). Recommend a migration note in the changelog and opt-in beta for customers wanting stability guarantees.

amy (PM): Decisions I'm leaning to (call to action): default `top_k=10`, self-serve max `200`, enterprise-configurable max via contract; return `scores` (raw) + optional `normalized_scores`; default `truncate_policy=truncate` with `X-Rerank-Warning` header; expose `norm_method` param. Anyone opposed?

raj (eng): :thumbsup: I can prototype server truncation + warning header and the `413` path for very large payloads.

sofia (ml): :thumbsup: I'll implement normalization modes and add drift metrics (KL / JS divergence) to detect score distribution shifts.

tara (cs): :thumbsup: I'll prep customer comms + beta invites for Dropbox and Ecom.

mike (devex): :eyes: I'll open SDK PRs for JS/Python and draft migration guide.

amy (PM): Thanks all — I'll write the spec doc and create tickets. Action items: amy write spec & tickets, raj prototype, sofia metrics, mike SDK + guides, tara customer comms. Lock decisions by Friday — ping me if any blockers.
